text.en: In Canada, no one is forced to do military service.
text.fr: Au Canada, personne n'est obligé de faire son service militaire.

source.quote: There is no compulsory military service in Canada.

verification.evidence: There is no compulsory military service in Canada.

text.en: Still, joining the regular Canadian Forces is an honourable way to serve Canada, and it is an excellent career. The regular forces are the navy, the army and the air force.
text.fr: Cependant, s'engager dans la force régulière des Forces canadiennes est une façon honorable de servir le Canada, et c'est une excellente carrière. La force régulière comprend la marine, l'armée de terre et l'aviation.

source.quote: However, serving in the regular Canadian Forces (navy, army and air force) is a noble way to contribute to Canada and an excellent career choice (www.forces.ca).

verification.evidence: There is no compulsory military service in Canada. However, serving in the regular Canadian Forces (navy, army and air force) is a noble way to contribute to Canada and an excellent career choice (www.forces.ca).

text.en: You can also serve part-time, close to home, in the navy reserves, the militia or the air reserves. You gain useful experience and skills there, and you meet people.
text.fr: Vous pouvez aussi servir à temps partiel, près de chez vous, dans la réserve navale, la milice ou la réserve aérienne. Vous y gagnez une expérience et des compétences utiles, et vous rencontrez des gens.

source.quote: You can serve in your local part-time navy, militia and air reserves and gain valuable experience, skills and contacts.

verification.evidence: You can serve in your local part-time navy, militia and air reserves and gain valuable experience, skills and contacts.

text.en: Young people who join the cadets can learn discipline, responsibility and skills.
text.fr: Les jeunes qui se joignent aux cadets peuvent apprendre la discipline, le sens des responsabilités et des compétences.

source.quote: Young people can learn discipline, responsibility, and skills by getting involved in the cadets (www.cadets.ca).

verification.evidence: Young people can learn discipline, responsibility, and skills by getting involved in the cadets (www.cadets.ca).

text.en: Another way to serve is in the Coast Guard, or in your community's emergency services, such as the police or the fire department.
text.fr: Une autre façon de servir est de travailler dans la Garde côtière, ou dans les services d'urgence de votre collectivité, comme la police ou le service des incendies.

source.quote: You may also serve in the Coast Guard or emergency services in your community such as a police force or fire department.

verification.evidence: You may also serve in the Coast Guard or emergency services in your community such as a police force or fire department.

text.en: When you help protect your community, you follow the path of earlier Canadians who made sacrifices to serve their country.
text.fr: Quand vous aidez à protéger votre collectivité, vous suivez le chemin des Canadiens qui vous ont précédé et qui ont fait des sacrifices pour servir leur pays.

source.quote: By helping to protect your community, you follow in the footsteps of Canadians before you who made sacrifices in the service of our country.

verification.evidence: By helping to protect your community, you follow in the footsteps of Canadians before you who made sacrifices in the service of our country.
